title: Why This Is Really The Planet Of The Bugs
hook: Most of the bugs crawling around you have never even been given a name.
closing: Most bugs are still unnamed, so we barely know who we share this planet with.
question: Weirdest bug you've ever seen? Tell me below.

segments.say: Roughly eight out of every ten animal species are insects, so the animal kingdom is mostly bugs, and we are the small minority.
Beetles alone have about 1.5 million species, while mammals and birds together are a tiny fraction of that. Bugs win by a landslide.
We've named about one in five insect species scientists think exist. That means most bugs out there have never even had a name.
